title: AI Infrastructure & Compute
businessQuestion: What thermal density and cluster networking limits dictate gigawatt-scale data center design?
investorQuestion: Who captures sustained margin: custom accelerator designers, server integrators, or optical transceivers?
overview: The record set splits into optics, packaging, cooling and power delivery — the physical constraints on scaling accelerator clusters. Only a handful of entries reach mass production, which means the sector rewards suppliers already qualified into accelerator supply chains; the rest are option value on a broader re-architecture of the data centre.
